rules.name: Strict Non-Inference for Unauthorized Users
rules.description: Users without Cuidado Pastoral permissions (pastoral_core or assigned_team) must NEVER see any indicator, badge, zero counter, empty timeline section, tab, or metadata that reveals or suggests the existence of a pastoral case or confidential note.

rules.name: Persona 360 Privacy Shield
rules.description: In Persona 360 profile view, the 'Cuidado Pastoral' tab or section badge is ONLY rendered if accessControl.hasPastoralAccess(user) evaluates to true. For unauthorized users, the UI renders as if the module does not exist. No 'Acceso Denegado' placeholder, no disabled button.

rules.name: Pastoral Vault Visual Partitioning
rules.description: Within Pastoral Care cases, notes are partitioned: 'pastoral_core' (pastors & general coordinators) can read/write encrypted pastoral vault notes; 'assigned_team' can view operational progress and public updates but NOT confidential vault notes.

rules.name: Audit Log Badge & Append-Only Indicator
rules.description: Vault notes show an explicit security badge: 'Bóveda Cifrada | Auditado'. Notes cannot be edited or deleted once created (append-only timeline with view audit tracking).

rules: Operación 72 triggers automatically when a person accepts Jesus for the first time.
Single historical record per person_id with immutable original conversion date.
Re-entry logic: If a person returns after months or years, reactivate the existing record from the last completed valid stage without creating duplicate Person, expediente, or enrollment.
Timers: 24h assignment timer (Red SLA alert if unassigned) & 72h contact timer (Amber/Red SLA alert if uncontacted).
Distinct scope: Operación 72 = immediate contact response; Consolidación = formative process; Cuidado Pastoral = full case file and ongoing accompaniment.
ui_components: SlaTimerCountdown: Real-time visual countdown with progress ring and SLA status color.
HistoricalStageTimeline: Interactive stage history showing completed, reactivated, and current active stages.
ReactivationAlertBanner: Gold badge indicating 'Expediente Histórico Reactivado (Continuación de última etapa validada)'.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Maintain strict compatibility with existing VEN Y VE 360 styling tokens (Navy #1B2A4A, Gold #C8A951, Spectral font for headers, IBM Plex Sans for body).
2. All files created under src/ must be JavaScript (.js) files.
3. ALWAYS implement data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, badge, case row, and modal container (e.g. data-testid="op72-reactivate-btn", data-testid="pastoral-vault-note-input").
4. Enforce strict visual privacy: Wrap pastoral components in access checks (e.g., accessControl.hasPastoralAccess(user)). Unauthorized users MUST NOT see any pastoral UI or inferrable counters.
5. In Operación 72 views, ensure the single historical record badge and reactivation stage logic are clearly highlighted in the UI.
6. Use Sonner toasts for all action feedback (e.g. 'Nota pastoral cifrada y guardada en bóveda', 'Caso pastoral escalado con éxito').
7. Include comprehensive desktop and mobile responsive layouts for all 5 pastoral pages.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: All buttons, tabs, input elements, badges, timeline events, and card items MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.privacy_rule: Strict anti-inference RBAC visual insulation. Never display empty pastoral tabs or counters to unauthorized users.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_tokens: Navy primary (#1B2A4A), Gold accent (#C8A951), White/Ivory surface (#FAF8F5), Red SLA (#EF4444), Amber SLA (#F59E0B), Emerald SLA (#10B981).
